_note: Where the calculator reads its two data documents from.
The page tries Supabase first, then falls back to data/characters.json and
data/rotations.json in this repo. If Supabase is unreachable, misconfigured or
empty, the page still works — it just uses the committed files.
Set enabled:false to ignore Supabase entirely and always read the local files.
The key below is the PUBLISHABLE (anon) key. It is meant to be public. It grants
SELECT on wuwa.docs and nothing else — every other table in the project is
protected by its own row-level security.
Writes never happen from the page. Claude updates wuwa.docs through the Supabase
MCP, or you run tools/sync-supabase.mjs to push the local files up.
